sections.heading: Biography
sections.content: Sam Ananias Cases is a Computer-focused Industrial Technology graduate based in Cebu, Philippines. He focuses on software engineering fundamentals, structured problem decomposition, web standards, and leveraging AI responsibly as an interactive development partner.

sections.heading: Philosophy
sections.content: I believe in building software thoughtfully—thinking through requirements before implementation, documenting key decisions for future context, evaluating trade-offs, and verifying every build through test suites.
